messages:
sam: Hey — small onboarding snag. My 1Password invite landed at sam.redwood@gmail.com but my Google/Okta primary is sam.r@redwood.ai. Okta shows both sam.r and sam.redwood as accounts. Who should I ping to reconcile so I can finish setup? cc @morgan

it-bot: New user provision request received for sam.r@redwood.ai (ID: 15872) — pending verification

morgan: @sam can you drop your employee id here or DM me? Also did you ever sign up with your personal Gmail to access a shared drive/repo?

sam: employee id 15872. yeah i tried joining a shared folder a while back and maybe used my personal gmail to accept an invite — unsure if admin accepted it.

lindsey-devex: heads up: 1Password sends invites to the primary Google Workspace email on the account. If there's an external/personal address linked we usually have identity@ merge or remove the external entry. @morgan can you escalate to identity?

morgan: looking now — I can see two entries in the directory: sam.r@redwood.ai (primary) and sam.redwood@gmail.com (external entry). I'll unlink the external entry and trigger a re-send of the 1Password invite to sam.r@redwood.ai. Need you to confirm you can receive to sam.r@. ETA ~20m.

jordan: LMK if you want me to poke identity as well, happy to escalate so you don't wait.

sam: please go ahead w/ the unlink + resend to sam.r@redwood.ai — thanks.

morgan: done unlinking the external record and resent the invite. You should see an email from 1Password shortly. If you don't, try an incognito window to avoid stale SSO cookies: `https://1password.com/signin/redwood`

it-bot: 1Password invite delivered to sam.r@redwood.ai — invite_id: inv_8q3jf. Okta directory reconciled (sam.redwood external removed).

sam: got it, accepted and completed MFA setup with Authenticator app. All set! :tada: Thanks @morgan @lindsey-devex :thumbsup:

morgan: awesome — welcome aboard! If anything else blocks you ping #help or @identity.
